The event was projected to draw over 4,200 athletes and officials from across South Asian member countries. Pakistan Olympic Association President Arif Saeed had previously maintained that the nation possessed full government backing, secured funding, and adequate preparedness to successfully host the multi-sport gathering.

This fresh postponement casts further doubt on Pakistan's capacity to host the regional event after years of setbacks. A well-placed source indicated that organizers will strive to hold the competition toward the end of next year, though it could face further deferral to 2028 if conditions do not permit. Competing timelines with the Asian Indoor and Martial Games and seasonal challenges, such as winter smog in Lahore preventing outdoor events, continue to complicate planning for organizers evaluating alternative options.

stories.title: PTI Leaders Debate New Provinces and Internal Reforms in Meeting
stories.summary:
Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf leaders representing Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Balochistan have indicated support for establishing new provinces during a Core Committee meeting. Conversely, the Sindh chapter adopted a nuanced stance, noting that urban sectors favor the division while rural populations object. The Sindh leadership recommended appointing a committee to study the matter and draft formal recommendations.

During the discussions, participants voiced discontent regarding senior party office-bearers. A majority argued that a small faction of three or four influential figures had been making unilateral choices, which ultimately damaged the organization. Concerns were also raised regarding Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, considered the party founder's core political stronghold, which allegedly faced setbacks after leadership responsibilities were handed to Sohail Afridi.

To tackle internal dissent and boost party democracy, several committee members advocated for conducting fresh intra-party elections. These measures aim to resolve ongoing organizational grievances and recalibrate the leadership structure in line with grassroots expectations and broader political objectives.

Additionally, senior party figure Latif Khosa briefed the gathering on his dialogue with the jailed party founder. According to Khosa, the founder acknowledged missing multiple political chances and advised that the party pivot toward pursuing the creation of new provinces given the current political climate.

stories.title: Pakistan and Aga Khan Institutions Partner to Revamp Karachi Museum
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for National Heritage and Culture Aurangzeb Khan Khichi met with a delegation from Aga Khan University and the Aga Khan Trust for Culture in Islamabad to discuss modernizing the National Museum in Karachi. The comprehensive project aims to transform the venue into a contemporary cultural institution prioritizing research, public engagement, and tourist appeal.

During the discussions, Minister Khichi commended the planning efforts and emphasized the significance of public-private partnerships in preserving Pakistan's cultural heritage. Federal Secretary Asad Rehman Gilani echoed these sentiments, suggesting a three-month timeframe to establish funding structures and legal frameworks by forming joint teams from the government and the Aga Khan Trust for Culture.

Mr. Luis Monreal, General Manager of the Aga Khan Trust for Culture, presented the restoration concept, which includes upgraded building facilities, specialized conservation laboratories, paper conservation, and digitisation tools. The revitalized site would feature a dedicated research center, library, curriculum-linked educational visits, visitor amenities, and a professional management team.

The high-level delegation featured Aga Khan University President Dr. Sulaiman Shahabuddin, General Manager Luis Monreal, Vice Provost Professor Anjum Halai, and Institute for the Study of Muslim Civilisations Dean Professor Shahzad Bashir. Special Assistant to the Prime Minister Huzaifa Rehman and Department of Archaeology and Museums Director General Syeda Tanzeela Sabahat also participated in the meeting.

stories.title: Bayern Munich Faces Musiala Salary Dispute Amid Injury Crisis
stories.summary:
As Bayern Munich prepares for an away Champions League fixture against Lille, the club is grappling with internal turmoil surrounding midfielder Jamal Musiala alongside a severe injury crisis. Currently sitting 13th in the table, Bayern need points to secure a top-eight finish and avoid an extra playoff round. The team's injury list expanded further after Ballon d’Or winner Harry Kane sustained an ankle injury ruling him out until February.

Despite Musiala returning from a two-month layoff following a pre-season neurological disorder and field collapses, club executives publicly suggested the 23-year-old accept a pay cut. Karl-Heinz Rummenigge told German television that Musiala might not regain his previous form due to his medical condition, echoing remarks from Uli Hoeness and CEO Jan-Christian Dreesen. The timing of these comments, arriving just before record revenues were announced, drew sharp criticism.

The remarks triggered widespread backlash from player unions, with FIFPRO condemning the club's coordinated pressure campaign. German counterpart VDV president Carsten Ramelow labeled the statements an 'own goal' that would leave a lasting impression. Meanwhile, club figures including coach Vincent Kompany and sporting director Max Eberl voiced public support for Musiala, emphasizing his vital role for the team.

Musiala faces heightened expectations due to Bayern's extensive injuries, which sideline Serge Gnabry, Alphonso Davies, Ismael Saibari, and captain Manuel Neuer, alongside doubts over Michael Olise and Luis Diaz. Addressing fan expectations at a recent event, Musiala noted he is still learning to balance pressure and his hunger for victory.

stories.title: Kevin De Bruyne Affirms Affection for Manchester City Leadership Despite Charges
stories.summary:
Napoli playmaker Kevin De Bruyne stated on Monday that his fondness for Manchester City's hierarchy remains untainted by the club's financial rule breaches. De Bruyne prepares to return to the Etihad Stadium for a Champions League fixture on Tuesday, a little over a year following the conclusion of his decade-long tenure in Manchester. During his illustrious era with the English powerhouse, the Belgian secured six Premier League titles and a Champions League trophy, cementing his status as a club legend.

However, those accomplishments face potential consequences if Manchester City fails to successfully overturn a verdict finding them guilty of over 100 infractions of Premier League financial regulations between 2009 and 2018. If the ruling stands, the club could encounter significant point deductions, relegation from the top flight, or even the stripping of previous titles. Despite this uncertainty, De Bruyne expressed enduring pride in his playing career and deep affection for chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak and the club's owners.

The Belgian midfielder dismissed notions that his on-field achievements are compromised by the financial misconduct allegations. Emphasizing that he competed strictly between the white lines and played within the limits, De Bruyne underscored that his fondest memories rest on his experiences with teammates and matches played. He noted that the care shown to him and his family over ten years leaves him with purely positive feelings toward the organization.

On the field, the two clubs face contrasting fortunes in European competition ahead of their meeting. Napoli sits 27th in the 36-team Champions League table after losing three of their first four matches, leaving them vulnerable to an early exit, while only the top 24 advance. Conversely, Enzo Maresca's Manchester City side has won three of their initial four European matches to secure a spot in the top eight, which grants direct progression to the last sixteen.

stories.title: PSL 12 Franchises Secure High-Profile Marquee Direct Signings for Upcoming Tournament
stories.summary:
Pakistan Super League (PSL) franchises have announced their marquee direct signings ahead of the player auction scheduled for January 23, 2027. Islamabad United added New Zealand fast bowler Matt Henry to their squad, bringing the experienced 34-year-old seamer into the tournament for his debut appearance. Meanwhile, Karachi Kings secured England leg-spinner Adil Rashid, a pivotal member of the white-ball teams that triumphed in the 2019 ICC World Cup and the 2022 T20 World Cup, in a deal valued at approximately Rs6.2 crore.

Multan Sultans also utilized the direct-signing provision by enlisting Australian right-arm fast bowler Lance Morris, known for his express pace and previous stints with the Melbourne Stars and Perth Scorchers in the Big Bash League. Additionally, Lahore Qalandars unveiled Sri Lankan batter Kamindu Mendis as their primary direct acquisition. The direct-signing window, operating from October 23 to November 23, permitted each of the eight participating franchises to recruit one overseas marquee player who did not participate in PSL 10 or PSL 11.

Under tournament regulations, teams utilizing a direct signing experience an increase in their salary cap from Rs45 crore to Rs50.5 crore. Franchises are permitted a maximum of seven player retentions, including their direct signing, with the retention deadline set for January 13, 2027. Teams retaining their full quota must release one player from the highest price tier of the previous auction into the general player pool. Other franchises have been linked to potential moves for players such as New Zealand pacer Lockie Ferguson.

The twelfth edition of the Pakistan Super League is scheduled to run from March 18 to May 2, 2027. The tournament will encompass 44 matches distributed across five to six distinct venues. The Pakistan Cricket Board previously confirmed that Peshawar will host both the opening ceremony and the inaugural match of the competition.

stories.title: Karachi Traffic Police Launch Clampdown Operation Against Fake Vehicle Number Plates
stories.summary:
Karachi Traffic Police have established a specialized clamping team to target motorists utilizing fake, concealed, or tampered registration plates. The unit has officially commenced operations along Shahrah-e-Faisal to detect vehicles displaying illegal or suspicious number plates designed to evade the city's automated e-challan system. DIG Traffic Pir Muhammad Shah noted that despite the TRACS service operating for over a year, certain drivers continue altering their plates intentionally to bypass traffic penalties.

Under the new directive, the specialized team will physically inspect suspicious automobiles and immobilize any vehicle found with altered, removed, or fabricated plates on the spot. DIG Pir Muhammad Shah emphasized that these vehicles will remain impounded and will not be released until owners present their original registration plates alongside relevant vehicle documentation. The enforcement protocol involves a two-step procedure consisting of an initial visit to clamp the vehicle and a subsequent visit to remove the device once conditions are met.

Motorists whose vehicles are immobilized will receive a traffic violation ticket accompanied by additional clamping charges. Furthermore, vehicle owners must settle a fine of Rs2,000 with the traffic police to secure the release of a clamped vehicle. The authorities warned that owners failing to respond promptly will have their immobilized vehicles towed to the nearest traffic police post.

The ongoing crackdown seeks to reinforce traffic law compliance and ensure individual accountability across Karachi's faceless e-challan network. Officials reiterated that concealing, erasing, or substituting vehicle registration plates constitutes a serious legal violation, warning motorists against attempting to bypass electronic enforcement through unlawful means.

stories.title: Punjab Government Enforces Three-Day Section 144 Restrictions Across Lahore
stories.summary:
The Punjab government enacted Section 144 throughout Lahore on Tuesday, citing ongoing law and order concerns. Capt. (Retd.) Muhammad Ali Ijaz, the Lahore Deputy Commissioner, released the formal notification to implement the restrictions for a duration of three days across the provincial capital.

Simultaneously, a formal petition reached the Lahore High Court regarding police deployments around the home of Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam-Fazl chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman. Lawyer Abrar Hussain submitted the filing, naming senior figures such as the Punjab Inspector General of Police and Lahore CCPO as respondents.

The court document claims that roughly 3,000 police officers surrounded the JUI-F leader's residence to restrict his movement without official legal paperwork or detention orders. Furthermore, the petition states that authorities barred visitors from entering the premises to meet with him.

The legal filing asks the judiciary to order the removal of the police deployment and guarantee the protection of the politician's fundamental rights. Additional court hearings and proceedings are anticipated following the submission of the petition.

stories.title: Lahore High Court Receives Petition Challenging Police Deployment Around Fazl's Home
stories.summary:
A legal challenge was submitted to the Lahore High Court on Tuesday regarding the alleged confinement of Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam-Fazl leader Maulana Fazlur Rehman at his residence. Advocate Abrar Hussain filed the petition, which has not yet been formally scheduled for a hearing by the court.

The legal filing asserts that approximately 3,000 security personnel encircled the politician's home, blocking him inside. The lawyer stated that police failed to provide official documentation authorizing the confinement and refused to grant him entry to see the JUI-F chief.

Ahead of the petition, the party shared on X that Fazl arrived in Lahore on Monday night to address local lawyers at the invitation of the Lahore High Court Bar Association. However, the heavy security presence prevented him from departing from his property.

This development occurs amid heightened friction between the JUI-F leader and the federal administration, which intensified in October after Fazl criticized the center over governance issues in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Recently, security details guarding Fazl and his family in Islamabad and Dera Ismail Khan were also scaled back.

stories.title: India's 2036 Olympic Bid Faces Scrutiny Amid Internal Governance Disputes
stories.summary:
Experts warn that India must quickly resolve internal conflicts within its Olympic association to bolster its candidacy for hosting the 2036 Olympic Games. The International Olympic Committee recently voiced disappointment regarding regrettable schisms inside the Indian Olympic Association, noting that these divisions harm the reputation of the Olympic movement.

India is competing alongside six other nations—Germany, Hungary, Qatar, South Africa, South Korea, and Turkey—to host the 2036 event. An Indian delegation comprising IOA president P.T. Usha, IOC member Nita Ambani, and government officials from Gujarat is scheduled to present its proposal to the IOC's Future Host Commission in Switzerland on Thursday.

Internal friction has flared up ahead of the IOA executive council elections set for December 5. P.T. Usha initially faced exclusion from the presidential race amid nomination controversy and fraud allegations before securing a nomination from another federation. Sports analysts note that governance flaws and election disputes continue to plague the organization despite upcoming international presentations.

Despite the controversy, some observers suggest the IOC's dissatisfaction will not derail the host city selection process, which features Ahmedabad as a proposed hub. Ahmedabad is also designated to host the 2030 Commonwealth Games as a major preparation milestone.

stories.title: PML-N Succession Debate Emerges Over Potential Leadership Shift to Maryam Nawaz
stories.summary:
Discussions are reportedly brewing within the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz regarding a potential leadership transition from former prime minister Nawaz Sharif to his daughter, Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz. Political analyst Muhammad Malick stated that a faction within the ruling party is actively advocating for her elevation to party president to position her as the prime ministerial candidate for the 2029 general elections.

Proponents of the transition argue that Nawaz Sharif has largely stepped back from active politics due to health concerns and view Maryam's performance as Punjab chief minister as a strong qualification. However, Nawaz Sharif is reportedly opposed to the change, believing it could disrupt the existing balance of power within the political landscape.

Analysts note that any alteration at the top of the PML-N could carry implications beyond internal party dynamics. Observers suggest that the current working relationship between the party and state institutions involves specific individuals, meaning a leadership change could potentially alter the broader political arrangement and affect Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's standing.

Furthermore, a shift in federal leadership could prompt questions regarding who might succeed Maryam as the chief minister of Punjab and whether the party's approach toward regional governance and provincial creation might evolve. Any reshuffle at the highest level of the party risks overreaching political ambition and redefining traditional alliances.

stories.title: Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi Seek Live Coverage of £190m Case Appeal
stories.summary:
A legal request has been submitted to the Islamabad High Court asking for live-streaming of the upcoming appeal hearings for former prime minister Imran Khan and his wife, Bushra Bibi. Barrister Salman Safdar filed the miscellaneous plea to ensure transparency, provide public access to judicial events, and boost confidence in the legal system.

The scheduled appeals will be reviewed by IHC Chief Justice Sardar Muhammad Sarfraz Dogar and Justice Muhammad Asif. The legal challenge addresses the convictions handed down by an accountability court on January 17, 2025, in the Al-Qadir Trust case, which involves a total value of £190 million.

Under the previous accountability court ruling, Imran was sentenced to 14 years in prison alongside a Rs1 million fine, while Bushra received a seven-year sentence and a fine of Rs500,000. Additionally, the initial verdict ordered the seizure of the Al-Qadir University Project Trust property by the federal government.

The underlying prosecution centers on a financial settlement between Britain's National Crime Agency and property tycoon Malik Riaz. Authorities alleged that funds sent back to Pakistan were improperly used to pay off a Supreme Court fine against Riaz instead of entering the national treasury, and that the couple accepted land from Riaz in exchange for political favors during Imran's time in office.

stories.title: ICC Maintains Saliva Ban Despite India Captain Shubman Gill's Objections
stories.summary:
The International Cricket Council has confirmed it has no immediate intention to discard the prohibition on using saliva to shine cricket balls. This stance persists despite public comments from India's Test captain, Shubman Gill, who argued that the regulation should be eliminated to assist bowlers with reverse swing following a drawn opening Test against New Zealand in Wellington.

The rule against applying saliva is treated with the same strictness as other illegal methods of altering a ball's condition. Regulating the practice remains challenging because mixing saliva with external substances like sweets, mints, or chewing gum can heavily modify the ball. Originally introduced temporarily in 2020 due to the pandemic, the ban was made permanent two years later.

Gill expressed frustration over the continued restriction, noting that pandemic conditions have long passed and pointing to the regulation as a major reason bowlers struggle to take wickets. During the Wellington match, India declared their first innings at 720-9, while New Zealand held out for 120 overs to finish at 239-5.

While the Indian Premier League removed its own saliva ban last year, international cricket retains the rule. Both teams are now traveling to Christchurch for the second and deciding Test match, where green and seamer-friendly pitches are anticipated by both captains.

stories.title: NCCIA Launches Cyber INFO App to Combat Online Crime and Promote Safety
stories.summary:
As modern daily activities increasingly shift online for financial transactions, bill payments, and administrative tasks, cyber-related offenses have seen a steady rise. To counter this growing digital threat, the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency has officially launched a new tool named the Cyber INFO App.

The newly introduced digital platform is specifically aimed at encouraging active public involvement in the fight against online crime. By facilitating user participation, the application seeks to foster a much safer and more secure environment across cyberspace for all internet users.

stories.title: SECP Lifts Lending Ban on RCDP After Clearing Company of Suicide Links
stories.summary:
The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan has officially withdrawn its temporary freeze on new loan disbursements by the Rural Community Development Programme. The regulatory body acted following an on-site inspection that cleared the organization and its personnel of any involvement in a reported suicide incident in Farooqabad, Sheikhupura district.

Police had previously registered a First Information Report on October 30 alleging that a man's death was connected to recovery pressures from RCDP staff regarding his wife's loan. In response, the SECP initiated an on-site review on November 1 and paused new lending on November 2. However, the victim's family subsequently withdrew their claims through written police statements and formal affidavits before a magistrate, leading the magistrate to discharge the staff and police to close the case.

Although the lending restriction was removed, the regulator's inspection uncovered notable weaknesses in RCDP's internal procedures concerning loan recovery and complaint management. The company was found to lack an approved recovery policy, sufficient documentation mechanisms, and proper escalation steps for borrower grievances.

As a condition of the lifted suspension, RCDP must submit a comprehensive compliance report within a 60-day window to address these identified administrative shortcomings. The institution currently manages an active client base of approximately 425,000 individuals across 36 districts, maintains an outstanding loan portfolio totaling Rs23 billion, and participates in financing for the Apni Chhat Apna Ghar housing initiative.

stories.title: جینسن ہوانگ کی اینویڈیا میں بحالی پر امریکی سیاست میں گرما گرمی
stories.summary:
اینویڈیا کے چیف ایگزیکٹیو آفیسر جینسن ہوانگ کو چینی انٹیلی جنس سے مبینہ روابط رکھنے والی خاتون سے تعلقات کے الزامات کے بعد استعفیٰ دینا پڑا تھا۔ تاہم، کمپنی کے حصص کو پہنچنے والے نقصان کے بعد انھیں دوبارہ منصب پر بحال کر دیا گیا ہے۔

امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے تصدیق کی ہے کہ انھوں نے خود اینویڈیا کے بورڈ آف ڈائریکٹرز کو قائل کیا کہ وہ ہوانگ کو واپس لائیں۔ اس فیصلے کے بعد کمپنی کے شیئرز میں 31 فیصد اضافہ ہوا اور مارکیٹ ویلیو میں نمایاں اضافہ ریکارڈ کیا گیا۔ بورڈ کا کہنا ہے کہ ہوانگ کی بحالی سے قومی سلامتی کو کوئی خطرہ نہیں ہے۔

اس فیصلے کے بعد امریکی سیاست میں شدید تنقید دیکھنے میں آ رہی ہے۔ ڈیموکریٹس اور بعض ریپبلکن قانون سازوں نے اس اقدام پر شدید تحفظات کا اظہار کیا ہے اور اسے قبل از وقت قرار دیا ہے۔ کانگریس کے مختلف اراکین نے اس معاملے اور ٹیکنالوجی کی منتقلی سے متعلق تحقیقات کا عزم ظاہر کیا ہے۔

جینسن ہوانگ رواں ماہ کے آغاز میں کانگریس کی مختلف کمیٹیوں کے سامنے بند کمرے کے اجلاس میں گواہی دینے والے ہیں۔ دوسری جانب، صدر ٹرمپ کی جانب سے اینویڈیا میں کی جانے والی سرمایہ کاری اور ان کے ذاتی مالی فوائد کے حوالے سے بھی سوالات اٹھائے جا رہے ہیں، جنہیں وائٹ ہاؤس اور صدر کی طرف سے مسترد کیا جا چکا ہے۔

stories.title: آزاد کشمیر میں انتشار کی ذمہ دار کالعدم کمیٹی ہے: طلال چوہدری
stories.summary:
وزیرِ مملکت برائے داخلہ طلال چوہدری نے اسلام آباد میں پریس کانفرنس کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ آزاد کشمیر میں انتشار پھیلانے والی کالعدم جوائنٹ ایکشن کمیٹی کو بھارت کی جانب سے فنڈنگ کی جا رہی ہے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ اس تحریک کو ایک مسلح تحریک میں تبدیل کرنے کی کوشش کی جا رہی ہے جو کہ حقوق کی کوئی تحریک نہیں۔

طلال چوہدری نے انکشاف کیا کہ گرفتار شدہ افراد سے تفتیش کے دوران مزید گرفتاریاں عمل میں لائی گئی ہیں، اور امتیاز اسلم اس کمیٹی کی کور کمیٹی کا رکن ہونے کے ساتھ ساتھ قیادت کے درمیان رابطہ کاری بھی کرتا ہے۔ انہوں نے بتایا کہ افغانستان سے اسلحے کی ترسیل سے متعلق اسلم امتیاز کی آڈیو بھی سامنے آ چکی ہے، جبکہ کشمیر میں خودکار بندوقیں اور جدید اسلحہ استعمال ہو رہا ہے۔

وزیرِ مملکت نے واضح کیا کہ حکومت کی جانب سے کمیٹی کے 37 مطالبات منظور کیے جا چکے ہیں، اس کے باوجود افغانستان اور بھارت کی پراکسیز کے ذریعے فساد پھیلایا جا رہا ہے۔ انہوں نے تنبیہ کی کہ سوشل میڈیا پر اس عمل کی تشہیر کرنے والوں کے خلاف بھی سخت قانونی کارروائی کی جائے گی۔

حکومت نے مؤقف اختیار کیا ہے کہ ریاست مزید خاموشی اختیار نہیں کرے گی کیونکہ اس سے مزید نقصان کا اندیشہ ہے۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ آزاد کشمیر حکومت کو ترقیاتی کاموں کے لیے مکمل اختیارات حاصل ہیں اور وہ جب چاہے وفاقی حکومت سے معاونت لے سکتی ہے۔

stories.title: پنڈدادن خان میں بھابھی کے قتل کا فرار ملزم انٹرپول کے ذریعے گرفتار
stories.summary:
پولیس نے پنڈدادن خان میں تین سال قبل اپنی بھابھی کو گھریلو ناچاقی کی بنیاد پر قتل کرنے کے بعد ملک سے فرار ہونے والے مطلوب ملزم کو گرفتار کر لیا ہے۔

حکام کے مطابق ملزم واردات کے بعد بیرون ملک فرار ہو گیا تھا، جسے انٹرپول کی معاونت سے حراست میں لیا گیا ہے۔ ملزم کی گرفتاری کے بعد پولیس کی جانب سے اس سے مزید تفتیش کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے۔

اس کارروائی کے علاوہ مختلف خبروں میں دیگر اہم ملکی و انتظامی امور کا ذکر بھی کیا گیا ہے۔ وزیراعظم شہباز شریف اور آزاد جموں و کشمیر کے وزیراعظم افتخار گیلانی کے درمیان ملاقات ہوئی ہے، جبکہ وزیراعظم نے وفاقی وزراء کو آپسی سیاسی بیان بازی سے گریز کی ہدایت کی ہے۔

اس کے علاوہ، مختلف حادثات، سکیورٹی اداروں کی کارروائیوں اور سرکاری امور سے متعلق دیگر اطلاعات بھی رپورٹس کا حصہ رہی ہیں جن میں منشیات کے خلاف کارروائیاں اور پی ڈی ایم اے یا ریسکیو کی سرگرمیاں شامل ہیں۔

stories.title: میلسی میں لاپتہ بچی کے قتل کا مبینہ ملزم خود کشی کر گیا
stories.summary:
پنجاب کے علاقے میلسی میں ایک دردناک واقعہ پیش آیا جہاں سات سالہ بچی کے مبینہ اغوا اور قتل کا ملزم پولیس کے تعاقب کے دوران خود کو گولی مار کر ہلاک ہو گیا۔ یہ واقعہ موضع چھتانیہ کے گاؤں حاجی متو سومرو میں پیش آیا، جہاں بچی چار روز قبل اپنے گھر سے لاپتہ ہو گئی تھی۔

ابتدائی معلومات کے مطابق ملزم نے مبینہ طور پر بچی کو گلا گھونٹ کر قتل کر دیا تھا۔ پولیس حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ جب علاقے میں سرچ آپریشن جاری تھا، تو اس دوران مبینہ ملزم بچی کی لاش کو کسی دوسری جگہ پر منتقل کرنے کی کوشش کر رہا تھا۔

پولیس کے دیکھ کر ملزم نے فرار ہونے کی کوشش کی اور پولیس کی جانب سے تعاقب کرنے پر اس نے خود کو گولی مار لی جس سے اس کی موقع پر ہی موت واقع ہو گئی۔

اس افسوسناک واقعے کے بعد پولیس نے بچی اور ملزم دونوں کی لاشوں کو تحویل میں لے کر اسپتال منتقل کر دیا ہے۔ حکام نے اس معاملے میں مزید قانونی کارروائی اور تحقیقات کا آغاز کر دیا ہے تاکہ واقعے کے تمام محرکات کو سامنے لایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: خلاء میں ذیشان علی نہیں بلکہ پورا پاکستان جا رہا ہے: وزیراعظم
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے پہلے خلاء باز ذیشان علی نے میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ انہیں امید ہے کہ یہ خلاء کا سفر آخری ثابت نہیں ہوگا بلکہ مستقبل میں ایسے مزید مشترکہ مشنز بھی منعقد ہوں گے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ چین اور پاکستان کے تعلقات ہمالیہ سے بلند اور سمندروں سے گہرے ہیں۔

ذیشان علی چینی خلائی مشن شین ژو 24 کے ذریعے خلاء میں روانہ ہونے والے ہیں اور وہ اس مشن میں بطور سائنسی ماہر شرکت کر رہے ہیں۔ انہوں نے بتایا کہ وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے ان سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا تھا کہ اس مشن میں صرف ذیشان علی نہیں بلکہ پورا پاکستان جا رہا ہے اور یہ ملک کے لیے فخر کا مقام ہے۔

خلائی مشن کی تیاریوں کے حوالے سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے ذیشان علی نے چینی خلائی مرکز کے عملے اور انتظامیہ کا شکریہ ادا کیا جنہوں نے انہیں بہترین تربیت فراہم کی۔ انہوں نے بتایا کہ چینی ساتھیوں کے ساتھ ان کے پیشہ ورانہ اور دوستانہ تعلقات قائم ہوئے ہیں۔

سپارکو اور چین کی خلائی ایجنسی کے اشتراک سے ہونے والے اس تاریخی مشن کے تحت پاکستانی خلاء باز خلاء میں تقریباً ایک ہفتہ قیام کرنے کے بعد واپس وطن لوٹیں گے۔ اس مشن کو پاکستان کے خلائی سفر میں ایک سنگ میل قرار دیا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: پی ٹی آئی اتحاد کی دعوت دینے سے پہلے خود اپوزیشن کا کردار ادا کرے: نیئر بخاری
stories.summary:
پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی پارلیمنٹیرینز کے سیکریٹری جنرل نیئر بخاری کا کہنا ہے کہ پاکستان تحریک انصاف کو دوسروں کو اپوزیشن کی دعوت دینے سے پہلے خود پارلیمنٹ کے اندر اور باہر اپوزیشن کا حقیقی کردار ادا کرنا چاہیے۔ انہوں نے پی ٹی آئی کی جانب سے ملنے والی مشروط اتحاد کی پیشکش پر ردعمل دیتے ہوئے یہ باتیں کہیں۔

نیئر بخاری کا کہنا تھا کہ پی ٹی آئی محض نعرے بازی کی بجائے ایک واضح سیاسی ایجنڈا لے کر سامنے آئے۔ انہوں نے تنقید کی کہ پی ٹی آئی کا واحد ہدف بانی تحریک انصاف کی رہائی کا مطالبہ رہ گیا ہے اور اب ان میں ہنگامہ آرائی کرنے کی سکت بھی باقی نہیں رہی۔

پی پی پی رہنما نے کہا کہ پارٹی چیئرمین بلاول بھٹو زرداری نے تحریک انصاف کو قائمہ کمیٹیوں میں واپس آنے کی دعوت دی تھی لیکن تاحال تحریک انصاف کی جانب سے اس دعوت کا کوئی جواب موصول نہیں ہوا۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ پیپلز پارٹی کی بنیادی پالیسی آئین کی بالادستی پر مبنی ہے۔

مختلف سیاسی معاملات پر بات کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے مسلم لیگ ن اور پی ٹی آئی دونوں سے نئے صوبوں کے قیام کے حوالے سے ان کی پالیسی پر وضاحت طلب کی اور پوچھا کہ دونوں جماعتوں کی قیادت اس اہم موضوع پر خاموش کیوں ہے۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ پیپلز پارٹی نے تاحال حکومت سے علیحدگی کا کوئی فیصلہ نہیں کیا ہے۔

stories.title: European Markets Open Muted as Technology Rally Loses Momentum
stories.summary:
European shares opened on a muted note on Tuesday following a technology-driven rally that had previously generated the strongest session in six months. By 0810 GMT, the pan-European STOXX 600 edged up by 0.1% to reach 637.43 points, following a significant daily jump recorded the day before. The previous session saw European technology stocks surge over 4% in their largest single-day gain since early April, largely lifted by Jensen Huang’s surprise reinstatement as CEO of US chipmaker Nvidia, which boosted risk appetite across the sector.

Despite the strong start, Tuesday's trading witnessed the momentum fizzle out, leaving the index down by 0.3%. Among individual tech stocks, Aixtron retreated 7.7% after UBS downgraded the chip systems manufacturer to a "sell" rating, erasing part of its previous gains. In contrast, Sanofi experienced a 4.5% surge after the French drugmaker announced plans to acquire US-based Insmed for $41 billion. This transaction represents the largest move yet under CEO Belen Garijo’s ongoing initiative to reshape the company, helping the broader healthcare index outperform peers with a 0.6% increase.

Additional market movement was seen in the construction and materials sector, which was boosted by a 5% gain from Balfour Beatty. The construction group announced that its operational revenue for the upcoming period is anticipated to be 10% higher than figures from 2025. While mixed performance defined the broader market, investors weighed sector-specific gains against the cooling of the recent artificial intelligence-led surge.

stories.title: JUI-F Files Petition in Lahore High Court Over Maulana Fazlur Rehman's Confinement
stories.summary:
A formal petition has been lodged in the Lahore High Court challenging the alleged police siege and confinement of Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman at his residence. The legal action was initiated by JUI lawyer Abrar Hussain, who named several senior law enforcement figures as respondents, including the Punjab Inspector General of Police and the Lahore Capital City Police Officer.

According to details outlined in the petition, approximately 3,000 police personnel have been deployed around the JUI-F leader's home, effectively restricting his movement. The petitioner claims that authorities carried out the blockade without presenting any official legal documentation or court order authorizing his detention. Furthermore, the petition states that police have denied visitors permission to enter the premises and meet with the opposition leader.

The legal filing requests the high court to order relevant authorities to immediately lift the police deployment surrounding the residence and ensure the protection of Maulana Fazlur Rehman's fundamental rights. Further court proceedings regarding the matter are expected to follow as the legal challenge moves forward in Lahore.

stories.title: Engro Holdings Proposes 60 Million Share Buyback to Optimize Capital
stories.summary:
The Board of Directors of Engro Holdings Limited has announced a proposal to buy back up to 60 million of its issued and paid-up ordinary shares. This proposed amount accounts for roughly 5.14% of the conglomerate's total outstanding stock. The listed company disclosed the plan in a notice sent to the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Tuesday, framing the initiative as a key component of its broader capital allocation strategy designed to enhance shareholder value.

Under the proposal, the maximum limit of 60 million shares is intended to give the firm flexibility to allocate capital when prevailing market prices fall below intrinsic values. The company intends to hold any purchased shares as treasury shares to maintain future capital allocation flexibility, potentially for employee incentive plans or providing liquidity to shareholders. The buyback will utilize cash out of distributable profits, adhering to Section 88(8) of the Companies Act, 2017, with shares purchased at spot prices between December 29, 2026, and June 22, 2027, or until completion.

The transaction remains subject to formal approval by shareholders through a special resolution at an upcoming Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for December 24, 2026, in Karachi. Engro Holdings Limited, formerly operating as Dawood Hercules Corporation Limited, adopted its current name following a 2024 restructuring proposal that brought Engro Corporation under its umbrella while preserving minority shareholders' economic ownership.

stories.title: ICC Confirms Saliva Ban Will Remain Despite Shubman Gill's Objections
stories.summary:
The International Cricket Council maintains that it has no plans to reverse the ban prohibiting players from applying saliva to shine the ball. This stance persists despite public calls from Indian cricket captain Shubman Gill to overturn the rule, which was initially introduced as a temporary precautionary measure during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020 before being made permanent two years later.

Gill voiced his opposition following India's high-scoring opening Test against New Zealand in Wellington, which ended in a draw after the tourists declared their first innings at 720-9 and New Zealand survived to reach 239-5. Gill argued that the restrictions should be lifted to help fast bowlers generate reverse swing, noting he does not understand why the practice remains barred years after the pandemic. However, the ICC treats the use of saliva similarly to other unfair methods of altering a ball's condition, noting that saliva combined with substances like mints or gum can materially change the ball and remains extremely difficult for officials to monitor.

While domestic competitions such as the Indian Premier League lifted their respective saliva bans last year, international cricket authorities see no reason to alter the regulation. Both teams are now preparing for the second and deciding Test in Christchurch, where captains anticipate a more seamer-friendly green pitch.

stories.title: PTI Asks Islamabad High Court for Live Al-Qadir Trust Appeal
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Tehreek-i-Insaf party has submitted a petition to the Islamabad High Court requesting a live broadcast of upcoming appeal hearings for the £190 million Al-Qadir Trust case. The legal filing centers on party founder Imran Khan and his wife, Bushra Bibi, who received convictions and prison sentences in January 2025 from an accountability court. The court ruled them guilty of accepting massive financial sums and extensive land tracts from a property firm to legalize fifty billion rupees that the United Kingdom had returned to Pakistan during a prior PTI administration.

Legal representatives Barrister Salman Safdar, Barrister Salman Akram Raja, and others submitted the documentation on a Tuesday. The submission contends that the high-profile matter holds immense national significance, making televised proceedings vital for transparency, fairness, and public trust in the judiciary. According to the petition, broadcasting the hearings lets citizens observe firsthand, clears up rumors, and fulfills the principle that justice must be visibly administered. The argument draws on Article 19-A of the Constitution regarding citizen information rights, alongside past live-streamed Supreme Court cases like the Zulfikar Ali Bhutto reference and Pervez Musharraf proceedings, plus prior Islamabad High Court directives for major cases.

Beyond media access, the filing highlights grievances regarding Imran Khan's imprisonment, citing solitary confinement, inadequate healthcare, blood pressure neglect, and blocked visits from family and legal counsel. It also mentions that verdict details leaked prior to official pronouncement, casting doubt on judicial fairness. The petitioners ask for complete appeal coverage to allow independent evaluation of all legal arguments.

The Islamabad High Court scheduled hearing dates for November 25, assigning the appeals to a division bench featuring Chief Justice Sardar Mohammad Sarfraz Dogar and Justice Muhammad Asif. Previously, senior PTI lawyers approached the Federal Constitutional Court requesting an expedited hearing for Bushra Bibi's criminal appeal. However, that court dismissed the plea to suspend her seven-year sentence, upholding an April 30 Islamabad High Court decision. Both individuals originally sought sentence suspensions through the high court in July of the prior year, but those requests were ultimately dismissed in May 2026 because their main conviction appeals were already scheduled for review.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz Urges Cabinet Ministers to Resolve Differences Amicably
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif addressed the federal cabinet in Islamabad on Tuesday, taking formal notice of provocative statements exchanged among cabinet members and urging them to settle their disputes through mutual consultation. This appeal follows a recent public war of words among coalition partners regarding a proposed referendum on creating new provinces. The political friction escalated after PML-N Senator Rana Sanaullah criticized Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi on Monday, claiming Naqvi complicated the provinces debate by making an irrelevant speech at the Pakistan Economic Summit in Islamabad in July.

Interior Minister Naqvi subsequently fired back at his critic, warning without naming Sanaullah that any direct comments from him would prevent the minister from showing his face. In response to the escalating tensions, a statement issued by the Prime Minister's Office emphasized that the federal government's primary focus remains on public welfare projects and moving from economic stability toward sustainable economic growth. Prime Minister Shehbaz highlighted that the administration has consistently promoted the politics of development and progress rather than internal conflict.

To prevent further negative impressions that divert attention from governance, the prime minister instructed all federal cabinet ministers to completely refrain from making political statements against one another. He stressed that matters among members must be resolved through consensus and mutual understanding, noting that ministers are performing well and should stay focused entirely on public service. Additionally, Prime Minister Shehbaz called on provincial government representatives to halt such statements and instead promote constructive dialogue to ensure political stability collectively.

stories.title: PTI Core Committee Members Criticize Leadership and Demand Party Reforms
stories.summary:
A meeting of the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) Core Committee in Islamabad witnessed heavy criticism directed at the party leadership, according to sources cited by ARY News on Tuesday. A majority of the participants expressed frustration with senior office-bearers, arguing that a small group of three or four influential leaders had been making major decisions independently, which they claimed had damaged the party. Members also raised concerns that Khyber Pakhtunkhwa had experienced setbacks after the provincial leadership was handed over to Sohail Afridi.

To address these organizational issues and enhance internal democracy, several committee members proposed holding fresh intra-party elections. During the meeting, senior leader Latif Khosa shared insights from a conversation with the party founder, who acknowledged that PTI had missed multiple political opportunities. Khosa reported that the founder suggested focusing on the creation of new provinces under current political conditions and discussing the matter thoroughly within the parliamentary party.

Discussions regarding the proposed creation of new provinces revealed varied stances across different regional chapters. Leaders representing Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Balochistan expressed support for establishing new provinces. In contrast, the Sindh chapter reported a split position, noting that urban areas favored new provinces while rural areas opposed the concept, prompting a suggestion to form a committee to review the issue and submit recommendations.

stories.title: Bitcoin Surges 17 Percent to Reach $64,500 Following Nvidia Rally
stories.summary:
Bitcoin experienced a sharp relief rally on Monday, November 23, jumping up to 5.4 percent intraday to reach $64,505 on Bitstamp. This upward movement followed news reports that Nvidia’s board had unanimously reinstated its founder, Jensen Huang, as chief executive officer. The rally helped Bitcoin recover from a weekend flash crash that had driven its value down to nearly $55,100, which was more than 17 percent below its 26-month low. Investor risk appetite rebounded quickly once the market learned of Huang's immediate reinstatement after the opening of US markets.

Nvidia shares experienced an intraday surge of up to 35 percent, adding roughly $1 trillion in market capitalization to close up 31.48 percent at $165.05. The broad market rebound also impacted major American benchmarks, with the NASDAQ Composite climbing up to 6.8 percent and closing 6.5 percent higher, while the S&P 500 gained 4.7 percent by the end of the session. The sudden market surge severely impacted bearish cryptocurrency traders, resulting in a liquidation wave where over $500 million in leveraged crypto positions were wiped out in under four hours leading up to 4:00 p.m. UTC, according to Coin Glass data.

Despite the strong bounce, technical analysts noted that Bitcoin still faces heavy overhead resistance. Crypto trader and analyst Michaël van de Poppe explained that bulls must reclaim specific daily simple moving averages, particularly the 200-day moving average, to sustainably extend the bullish trend. Reaching that level would represent a gain of around 30 percent from the lows recorded on Saturday. Experts also pointed out that Bitcoin's previous Q4 2023 moving-average death cross served as a continuation of the Q3 death cross, which many believe marked the macro low of $25,000.

stories.title: Engro Holdings Proposes Share Buyback of Up to 60 Million Shares
stories.summary:
Engro Holdings Limited has announced a proposal by its Board of Directors to repurchase up to 60 million of its issued and paid-up ordinary shares. This proposed figure represents approximately 5.14 percent of the company's total outstanding shares. The business conglomerate disclosed this plan in a formal notice submitted to the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Tuesday.

The initiative is designed to be part of the company's capital allocation strategy aimed at enhancing overall shareholder value. According to the enterprise, the buyback will provide optionality to allocate capital effectively when market prices fall below intrinsic value. Shares purchased through this initiative are intended to be held as treasury shares to maintain flexibility for future capital allocation and potential employee incentive plans.

The planned purchases will involve ordinary shares with a face value of Rs10 each, executed in cash from distributable profits under Section 88(8) of the Companies Act, 2017. The acquisition window is scheduled to run from December 29, 2026, to June 22, 2027, or until the purchase is completed. Purchases will be made at the spot price.

Execution of the proposed transaction depends on formal approval from shareholders at an Extraordinary General Meeting. This meeting is scheduled to take place on December 24, 2026, in Karachi. Formerly known as Dawood Hercules Corporation Limited, the organization rebranded as Engro Holdings Limited following a corporate restructuring approved in May 2024.

stories.title: State Bank of Pakistan Develops Comprehensive Artificial Intelligence Banking Guidelines
stories.summary:
The State Bank of Pakistan has formulated comprehensive guidelines governing the utilization of artificial intelligence within the nation's banking sector. Saleem Ullah, the Deputy Governor of the central bank, announced the development, highlighting that artificial intelligence serves as an effective medium for delivering modern and improved services to banking customers.

According to the central bank official, integrating advanced technology into financial operations will substantially elevate the overall performance of Pakistan's banking sector. The newly drafted guidelines establish operational parameters for artificial intelligence integration alongside guiding principles specifically created to mitigate potential risks associated with the technology across financial institutions.

Formal implementation of these regulatory guidelines across the banking sector will occur following their final approval. Industry stakeholders have also weighed in on the technological shift, noting that Pakistan is moving rapidly toward intelligent banking systems and emphasizing the critical importance of building a trustworthy economy.

Proponents of the transition maintain that while artificial intelligence acts as a powerful tool, sustainable progress requires robust governance that goes beyond routine compliance checklists. Experts suggest that future banking success will depend heavily on institutions remaining closely connected to their customer base.

stories.title: Child Assault Suspect Dies by Suicide After Police Spot Him in Mailsi
stories.summary:
A man suspected of involvement in the sexual assault and murder of a seven-year-old girl died by suicide in the Chattania area of Mailsi. Law enforcement reported that the victim, Dua Fatima, had been missing for the past four days before her body was discovered during a local search operation conducted by authorities.

According to police accounts, officers on a search team spotted a man carrying the child's body in an attempt to move it to another location. Upon noticing the approaching police personnel, the suspect dropped the body and fled the immediate area. Officers pursued the fleeing individual, who subsequently shot himself dead a short distance away.

Preliminary investigations conducted by the police indicate that the young girl had been subjected to sexual assault and murdered prior to the suspect's attempt to conceal the remains. Following the incident, a heavy contingent of police arrived at the scene to secure the area and recover both bodies for official procedures.

Both deceased individuals were transferred to the Tehsil Headquarters Hospital to undergo post-mortem examinations. Investigators have gathered physical evidence from the crime scene and initiated a formal inquiry to establish definitive conclusions regarding the exact cause of death and other related details.

stories.title: Zeeshan Ali Becomes First Pakistani Astronaut Aboard China's Space Station
stories.summary:
Muhammad Zeeshan Ali is set to make history as both the first Pakistani and the first foreign astronaut to visit China's Tiangong space station. He will participate in the Shenzhou-24 crewed spaceflight mission, which is scheduled to lift off from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center in northwest China on Wednesday.

Ali will serve as a payload specialist alongside Chinese astronauts Tang Hongbo and Wu Yi on the mission, which marks the 41st flight of China's crewed space program. Following a short-term joint spaceflight mission, Ali is scheduled to return to Earth aboard the Shenzhou-23 crewed spacecraft while the Shenzhou-24 crew performs in-orbit research and experiments.

Expressing his sentiments prior to launch, Ali stated that he carries the hopes of 250 million citizens on his shoulders and views the flight as a launch pad for future bilateral space cooperation involving missions to the moon, Mars, and beyond. Federal Minister for Planning and Development Ahsan Iqbal praised the historic milestone, noting that fellow Pakistani astronaut Khurram Dawood also completed training and joined meetings at the launch center.

Ahsan Iqbal highlighted the achievement as a profound source of national pride and encouraged young people to pursue ambitious goals through education and determination. The mission represents a significant expansion of space collaboration between Pakistan and China.

stories.title: Pakistani Prime Minister Orders Ministers to Halt Public Disputes and Focus on Governance
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has intervened in recent public spats among federal ministers, instructing his cabinet members to stop making critical statements against each other. During his remarks, the prime minister emphasized that internal disagreements should be resolved through mutual consultation, consensus, and understanding rather than public arguments that project a negative image of the administration.

The directive aims to redirect the government's entire attention toward public welfare initiatives, development projects, and transitioning the nation from economic stability to sustainable growth. Sharif highlighted that Pakistan has achieved notable successes internationally and diplomatically, noting that his administration has consistently prioritized constructive political development. He praised the ongoing efforts of his ministers while urging both federal and provincial representatives to avoid unnecessary public exchanges and foster positive dialogue.

Separately, internal political tensions surfaced within the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) party. According to media reports citing sources, a meeting of the PTI Core Committee featured sharp criticism directed at the party leadership. A majority of the participants complained that a small group of three or four influential leaders made major decisions independently, which they claimed had negatively impacted the party's interests.

The prime minister's intervention underscores the importance of administrative unity as the government navigates national governance and economic development challenges. By demanding an end to internal public friction, Sharif seeks to eliminate distractions and maintain executive focus on public service and welfare delivery across Pakistan.

stories.title: Millat Tractors Expands Into Electric Vehicles With Upcoming Launch of Lithium-Ion Bikes
stories.summary:
Millat Tractors Ltd (MTL) is set to diversify its business operations by launching five electric two-wheelers in Pakistan on November 29. The lineup includes lithium-ion-powered bikes and scooters produced by its subsidiary, Millat Industrial, which boasts an annual manufacturing capacity of 250,000 units. Dealerships have already been assigned, and production is currently underway as the company responds to rising consumer demand for affordable and green transportation amid high fuel costs.

Alongside its new venture, the company provided updates regarding its core tractor business. Under the FY26 Green Tractor Scheme, MTL sold approximately 15,000 out of 19,500 allocated tractors. While nearly 95 percent of the 10,000 high-horsepower tractors were sold, only about 50 percent of customers took delivery under the low-horsepower scheme. Management anticipates that industry volumes will gradually rebound from the current 28,000 to 30,000 units up to 35,000 units in the coming years, and eventually reach 50,000 units as farmer economics stabilize.

In terms of international trade, MTL exported roughly 1,384 units during FY26, which included 350 units sent to Afghanistan prior to a border closure. Following the closure, the company expanded its target export markets to Mexico and Africa. Leadership aims to double its non-Afghanistan exports from 1,000 units to 2,000 units, with Mexico projected to account for 600 to 700 units.

Millat Tractors currently holds about 65 percent of the tractor market share in Pakistan. The firm manufactures Massey Ferguson tractors under a licensing agreement with AGCO Ltd. UK, and forklift trucks under a license from China's Anhui Forklift Trucks. Company management noted that while its price per horsepower is lower than comparable competitors in India and China, building a presence in Africa will take time due to intense market competition.

stories.title: WNBA Player Sophie Cunningham Details Legal Proceedings Involving FBI Monitoring and Arrested Stalker
stories.summary:
Indiana Fever WNBA player Sophie Cunningham has spoken publicly about experiencing severe stalking and receiving death threats as her profile in the league has grown. Law enforcement agencies, including the FBI, are actively monitoring approximately 20 individuals linked to the harassment she faced, with one suspect currently held in custody following an arrest by authorities.

The arrested individual, identified as Kevin Singh, was taken into custody in late June 2026. He faces two felony counts of stalking and intimidation alongside a misdemeanor harassment charge in Marion County, Indiana. Prosecutors stated that the investigation began after a package was delivered in September 2025 to Gainbridge Fieldhouse, the home arena of the Indiana Fever. The package contained a cologne-scented Guns N' Roses T-shirt and a note addressed to Cunningham. Subsequent allegations revealed threatening social media interactions in early 2026, which escalated after the team issued a cease-and-desist warning.

Cunningham reported to police that the messages caused her significant fear and nightmares, leading her to stay home more often. At the time of his arrest, Singh was already on probation in another county following a prior conviction for invasion of privacy. A judge denied a request to reduce his $40,000 cash bail and GPS monitoring requirements. Singh remains detained pending a trial tentatively scheduled for early 2027, and he has not been found guilty of any charges in this ongoing case.

A native of Missouri who joined the Fever last season, Cunningham has frequently shared details about her farm animals, including miniature donkeys. She joked about the coincidence of having a pet miniature donkey named Kevin while dealing with a stalker of the same name. Her disclosures draw wider attention to the persistent safety concerns and threats that professional athletes continue to face, with specific FBI monitoring in place to ensure her protection.

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Bars Cabinet Ministers From Public Feuding Over New Provinces
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has instructed federal ministers to cease public criticism of one another and resolve their political disagreements through consultation and consensus. Issued by the Prime Minister's Office, the directive followed a heated public exchange between Adviser to the Prime Minister on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah and Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi regarding a controversial proposal to establish new provinces.

In his statement, Sharif emphasized that the federal government remains dedicated to public welfare and national development projects, aiming to guide Pakistan from economic stability to sustainable growth. He highlighted the administration's diplomatic successes and warned that political statements exchanged between cabinet colleagues project a negative image and distract from governing responsibilities. The prime minister also called on provincial representatives to embrace constructive dialogue and contribute to overall political stability.

The directive came on the heels of a public dispute between Sanaullah and Naqvi. Speaking on a television program, Sanaullah criticized Naqvi for failing to consult Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) leadership, such as Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari and Asif Ali Zardari, regarding the new provinces proposal over a four-month period, calling it a complete failure. This followed remarks from Naqvi warning an unnamed colleague against repeated public criticism. Sanaullah later confirmed that Naqvi's warning was directed at him.

Amid the political controversy surrounding the proposal, Naqvi met with Prime Minister Shehbaz to discuss national security and law and order, and separately consulted PML-Q President Chaudhry Shujaat Hussain in Lahore. The initiative to create new provinces has faced strong opposition from key coalition partners like the PPP, as well as opposition groups including the PTI and JUI-F.

stories.title: Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia Headquarters as CEO Following Reinstatement
stories.summary:
Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang received a rapturous welcome upon returning to the company's headquarters in Santa Clara, California, following his unanimous reinstatement as president, chief executive, and board member by Nvidia's board. Video footage from the office lobby showed employees cheering, chanting his name, and holding up phones as he walked through the building. Addressing the gathering, Huang expressed gratitude for the support and told employees he would strive to be a better CEO during his second tenure.

Huang's reinstatement takes effect immediately after he had previously resigned on November 12, during which time Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress served as interim CEO. Board chair Harvey Jones stated that the board held extensive discussions with Huang, noted his candor, and received input from senior United States government officials assuring that his return posed no national security risk. Jones expressed full confidence in Huang's leadership on behalf of the board, stockholders, employees, partners, and customers.

His original resignation followed reports regarding alleged extramarital relationships involving Nvidia employees and a woman suspected by US officials of ties to Chinese intelligence. Nvidia confirmed that an independent committee, assisted by outside legal counsel, is continuing its investigation into whether Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort, with Huang agreeing to cooperate fully. The ongoing probe addresses foreign intelligence concerns while the company moves forward under his reinstated leadership.

Additionally, US President Donald Trump claimed credit for securing Huang's return, stating in a CNBC interview that he spoke with Nvidia's board and persuaded them to bring the co-founder back. Huang has recently been engaged in discussions with the Trump administration regarding permission to sell advanced H200 chips to China. With Huang resuming his duties, Colette Kress returns to her role as executive vice president and chief financial officer, and Harvey Jones continues serving as board chair.

stories.title: Imran Khan Directs PTI to Expand Political Alliance and Reach Out to Opposition
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf core committee was informed that incarcerated party founder Imran Khan has directed the party to expand its political alliance and initiate outreach toward Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam-Fazl chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman alongside other opposition groups. The instructions were delivered during an overnight meeting by lawyer Latif Khosa, who briefed members on his recent meeting with Imran and Bushra Bibi at Adiala jail. The committee emphasized forming a broader political coalition to drive vigorous political activities moving forward.

During the meeting, chaired by Barrister Gohar Ali Khan, the core committee also addressed Imran's directive to debate the creation of new provinces in detail during the upcoming parliamentary party meeting. Furthermore, the committee voiced deep concern over the medical conditions of both Imran and Bushra Bibi. They demanded the immediate implementation of the Supreme Court's August 18 decision to transfer Imran to Shifa International Hospital in Islamabad, as well as judicial orders concerning medical care for Bushra Bibi.

The committee strongly condemned the continued detention of Sohail Afridi, the non-functional Khyber Pakhtunkhwa chief minister, and other PTI lawmakers under Section 3 of the Maintenance of Public Order. They appealed to the Federal Constitutional Court and its chief justice to modify existing stay orders and release political workers and leaders who received bail prior to November 5. Additionally, the committee decided to observe November 26 as Martyrs' Day to commemorate lives lost during the 2024 protests in Islamabad.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz Congratulates Field Marshal Asim Munir on Malaysia Hall of Fame Induction
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif congratulated Pakistan's Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of Army Staff, Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, on his induction into the Hall of Fame at Malaysia’s National Defence Studies Centre. Prime Minister Shehbaz noted on X that the distinction reflects the enduring friendship between Pakistan and Malaysia, praising the Field Marshal's resolute leadership during Marka-i-Haq, his commitment to national defense, and his efforts to promote international peace and elevate Pakistan's global standing.

The honor was formally presented during CDF Munir's official visit to Malaysia, aimed at strengthening bilateral defense and military cooperation between the two nations. As part of his itinerary, CDF Munir visited the National Defence Studies Centre for a formal ceremony inducting him as the 21st member of its Hall of Fame. Prime Minister Shehbaz emphasized that the recognition equally honors the brave armed forces personnel and the resilient people of Pakistan.

During his visit, CDF Munir met with Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim in Putrajaya to reaffirm their shared commitment to deepening bilateral defense ties. He also held discussions with Malaysian Defence Minister Mohamed Khaled bin Nordin. These engagements build upon previous diplomatic efforts, including an August agreement between Pakistan and Malaysia to establish a joint working group focusing on counter-terrorism, counter-narcotics, cybercrime, and the prevention of illegal immigration.

stories.title: Brentford Thumps Everton 4-0 as David Moyes' Milestone Match Ends in Heavy Defeat
stories.summary:
Everton suffered a heavy 4-0 defeat against Brentford, spoiling manager David Moyes' record-breaking 593rd match in charge of the club. Moyes had hoped to celebrate the milestone by guiding Everton into the Premier League's top five, but his team was thoroughly outplayed by an energetic Brentford side. The loss marked the heaviest defeat of Moyes' second spell as Everton manager, leaving his squad with significant ground to make up before hosting Liverpool in the upcoming Merseyside Derby.

The visitors' troubles deepened when captain James Tarkowski received a controversial red card late in the first half. With Brentford already leading 2-0 after 40 minutes, Tarkowski caught Yehor Yarmolyuk high on the shin with his studs during a follow-through while clearing the ball near the edge of the penalty box. Referee Craig Pawson initially issued a yellow card before upgrading it to a red upon review. Moyes admitted Tarkowski's foot was high but expressed uncertainty over whether the challenge warranted a sending-off.

Brentford capitalized on their numerical advantage in the second half, comfortably controlling the match and adding two more goals, highlighted by a stunning strike from Vitaly Janelt for the third. Brentford manager Keith Andrews celebrated the biggest win of his tenure, praising his team's tempo, energy, and overall performance. Moyes conceded that Everton's performance fell well below their recent standards and acknowledged that Brentford fully deserved their victory.

stories.title: MQM-P Urges Action Over Alleged Anti-State Slogans at Karachi Rally
stories.summary:
The Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan (MQM-P) has formally voiced strong objections regarding alleged anti-state slogans raised during a recent nationalist party rally held in Karachi. During a strategic meeting with a delegation from the Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP), MQM leader Dr Farooq Sattar pressed provincial representatives on what legal steps and arrests had been made following the demonstration.

In response to the concerns, the PPP delegation maintained that the event had concluded peacefully without significant incidents. However, Dr Sattar challenged this assessment, stating that video evidence could be provided and alleging that local party flags had been systematically removed during the gathering to deliberately provoke unrest in the metropolis.

The MQM-P further criticized local authorities and police for failing to intervene or make immediate arrests at the scene, accusing the provincial administration of giving the nationalist faction undue freedom to assert dominance. To help restore public order and demonstrate administrative impartiality, the MQM-P proposed that the government officially prohibit all political and nationalist rallies scheduled in Karachi for November 29.

Addressing this issue is considered vital for regional stability, as escalating tensions between rival political groups threaten local peace. The discussions highlight ongoing friction regarding political freedom, municipal security, and the enforcement of law and order across Karachi's sensitive political landscape.

stories.title: UN Report Reveals Over 47,000 Women Killed by Relatives in 2025
stories.summary:
A newly published United Nations report reveals that more than 47,000 women and girls were killed globally by relatives or intimate partners throughout 2025, averaging roughly five victims every hour. Compiled by UN Women and the UN Office on Drugs and Crime ahead of the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women, the findings indicate that this grim global total has remained largely consistent over recent years.

Out of 78,000 total intentional homicides involving female victims last year, approximately 60 percent occurred within the private sphere, representing 129 deaths daily. By comparison, only 11 percent of male homicide victims suffered a similar fate. The report emphasizes the critical necessity for prevention programs to target domestic relationships and broader family structures.

Regionally, Africa recorded the highest number of intimate partner and family-related female homicides with 22,100 victims, followed by Asia with 15,100, the Americas with 7,400, Europe with 2,100, and Oceania with 300. While overall global homicide rates have decreased, femicide rates have declined at a much slower pace in Europe and the Americas, pointing to deep-seated social norms, gender stereotypes, and persistent barriers to justice.

The data underscores a severe worldwide crisis regarding domestic violence and femicide, though tracking remains limited for crimes occurring outside private spheres, such as those tied to organized crime or human trafficking.

stories.title: Punjab Disaster Management Authority Issues Drought Warning for Southern Region
stories.summary:
The Provincial Disaster Management Authority (PDMA) of Punjab has issued an official alert warning of potentially worsening drought conditions across southern districts. In formal directives sent to regional district administrations and relevant government bodies, the agency stressed the urgent need for proactive mitigation strategies to cope with severe rainfall deficits.

According to forecasts from the Pakistan Meteorological Department (PMD), below-normal rainfall is anticipated across southern Punjab, Sindh, and Balochistan from December through February. This ongoing precipitation shortage follows months of severe dry spells, including extreme shortfalls in Sindh and Balochistan between July and November, which severely damaged agricultural productivity and threatened rain-fed farming communities.

The anticipated lack of water places immense strain on regional water resources and threatens crucial Rabi crops, particularly wheat, which serves as a major regional staple and a primary source of income for local farmers. The PDMA has instructed concerned authorities to utilize all available resources to combat the unfolding agricultural and humanitarian crisis.

This unfolding drought alert highlights the severe vulnerability of Pakistan's rural economy to climate fluctuations. Addressing these recurring water shortages is crucial for sustaining regional food security and protecting the livelihoods of millions of inhabitants dependent on seasonal agriculture.

stories.title: Al Ahly Dismisses Coach Hussein Ammouta Following Defeat by Pyramids
stories.summary:
Egyptian football giants Al Ahly have officially dismissed head coach Hussein Ammouta just hours after suffering a 2-0 home defeat against league leaders Pyramids. The loss left the club trailing seven points behind in the domestic title race and marked their first defeat in nine league matches of the current season. Club officials stated that a replacement for the Moroccan manager will be announced soon.

Ammouta, who assumed the role in June on a two-year contract following the departures of Jess Thorup, concluded a five-month tenure featuring 11 wins, two draws, and a single loss across 14 total matches. Despite keeping the team competitive across multiple cup tournaments, the 57-year-old coach faced mounting pressure from supporters due to inconsistent team performances.

Prior to joining Al Ahly, Ammouta enjoyed a highly decorated managerial career, guiding Wydad Casablanca to a Moroccan league and CAF Champions League double in 2017 by defeating Al Ahly in the final. His resume also includes an African Nations Championship title with Morocco in 2021, a Qatari league championship with Al Sadd, and coaching stints with Al Jazira and the Jordan national team.

Al Ahly, holding a record 45 Egyptian league titles, currently sit third in the standings behind Pyramids and second-placed Zamalek. Swiftly finding a new manager is vital for the club as they attempt to revive their championship campaign and appease passionate supporters.

stories.title: South Africa Seize Control Against Bangladesh on Day One in Centurion
stories.summary:
South Africa gained a commanding position on the opening day of the second Test against Bangladesh in Centurion on Monday. Rain delayed the start until after lunch, whereupon South Africa won the toss and elected to field. The home attack quickly dismantled the visitors, bowling them out for just 91 runs, which marked the lowest first-innings score in a Test match at Centurion.

Marco Jansen and Kagrab Rabada spearheaded the South African bowling performance. Jansen claimed 3-17, while Rabada finished with figures of 3-23 in nine overs. Early breakthroughs from Marco Jansen and returning fast bowler Anrich Nortje left Bangladesh reeling at 85-6 after the first session. Wiaan Mulder and spinner Simon Harmer also contributed to the bowling success before the tail was rapidly swept away after tea.

In response, South Africa reached 88-1 at stumps, trailing by only three runs. Marcus Ackerman finished the day on 46 not out alongside Zubayr Hamza, who was on nine overnight. Aiden Markram was the sole dismissal for the hosts, falling for 21 to Ebadot Hossain after earlier surviving an lbw review.

This match follows South Africa's nine-wicket victory in the first Test. The current fixture highlights the hosts' bowling dominance and puts them in a strong position to secure a series sweep as play continues.

stories.title: Injured Blair Tickner Ruled Out of New Zealand Test Squad
stories.summary:
New Zealand fast bowler Blair Tickner has been ruled out of the upcoming second Test against India due to a right-hamstring injury. The 33-year-old paceman sustained the injury during a training session in Wellington earlier in the week. New Zealand Cricket announced that Matt Fisher will replace Tickner in the squad for the match, which begins in Christchurch on Friday.

Tickner did not feature in the drawn first Test at the Basin Reserve, where India posted a formidable 720-9 declared in their sole innings. Team selectors might contemplate alterations to their pace attack following that high-scoring encounter. This latest roster change adds to New Zealand's mounting injury troubles, as frontline spinner Mitch Santner was already sidelined for the entire series after fracturing his right hand during the preceding one-day series against India.

The New Zealand squad for the second Test includes captain Tom Latham, Tom Blundell, Devon Conway, Jacob Duffy, Matt Fisher, Dean Foxcroft, Matt Henry, Kyle Jamieson, Daryl Mitchell, Henry Nicholls, Glenn Phillips, Rachin Ravindra, Nathan Smith, and Will Young. The team hopes these selections will help level or secure the series outcome in Christchurch.

Matters are further complicated by the challenging conditions anticipated in Christchurch. Both team captains expect a more traditional green, grassy, and seamer-friendly pitch for this decisive encounter, making the management of the remaining bowling resources critical for the Black Caps.

stories.title: Zeeshan Ali Set to Become Pakistan's First Astronaut in Space
stories.summary:
Mohammad Zeeshan Ali has been selected as a crew member for China's Shenzhou-24 space mission, making him the first Pakistani astronaut to undertake an orbital flight. Scheduled to launch on November 25 from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, Ali will also serve as the first foreign national to board Beijing’s Tiangong space station. Planning Minister Ahsan Iqbal and Information Minister Attaullah Tarar expressed national pride over the historic milestone.

Ali will travel aboard a Long March-2F rocket alongside mission commander Tang Hongbo and pilot Wu Yi. Serving as a payload specialist, Ali is expected to spend approximately a week in space conducting around 90 scientific experiments. China Manned Space Agency officials confirmed that the spacecraft and space station systems are fully operational and prepared for the mission objectives, which include crew rotation and ongoing maintenance.

During his time in orbit, Ali will work alongside current Tiangong occupants and eventually return to Earth alongside Hong Kong's first astronaut, Lai Ka-ying, and Zhang Zhiyuan aboard the docked Shenzhou-23 spacecraft. Other crew members will remain to conduct extended endurance tests. Ali completed rigorous training at the Astronaut Centre of China, learning the Chinese language and developing close cooperation with his international colleagues.

Addressing the public before launch, Ali emphasized that the flight represents the deep diplomatic ties and 75 years of space cooperation between China and Pakistan. He dedicated his journey to the hopes of 250 million Pakistanis and children watching the launch. Officials from both nations hailed the joint venture as a testament to peaceful space exploration and bilateral brotherhood.

stories.title: ICC Maintains Saliva Ban Despite Shubman Gill's Call for Change
stories.summary:
The International Cricket Council has confirmed it has no intentions to reverse the ban on applying saliva to shine cricket balls, despite recent calls from Indian captain Shubman Gill. Following a high-scoring drawn opening Test against New Zealand in Wellington, Gill argued that the restriction should be lifted to assist bowlers in achieving reverse swing. However, the governing body treats the practice similarly to other unauthorized methods of altering a ball's condition.

The temporary saliva ban was initially introduced in 2020 as a precautionary health measure during the COVID-19 pandemic and was made permanent two years later. Regulators note that saliva combined with substances like sweets or mints can materially alter the ball, and monitoring the rule remains exceedingly difficult. Fast bowlers traditionally rely on shining one side of an aging ball while keeping the other rough to generate late swing.

During the Wellington Test, India declared their first innings at 720-9, but New Zealand successfully batted through 120 overs to finish on 239-5 and secure a draw. Gill expressed frustration that the restriction remains in place years after pandemic protocols lapsed, pointing to the rule as a key factor in bowlers struggling to claim wickets. Although the Indian Premier League lifted its own saliva ban the previous year, the ICC maintains its stance for international competition.

India and New Zealand will now travel to Christchurch for the second and deciding Test starting on Friday. Captains from both sides anticipate a more traditional green, grassy, and seamer-friendly pitch for the upcoming match.

stories.title: Pakistan's First Astronaut Zeeshan Ali Set for Historic Tiangong Flight
stories.summary:
Pakistan is preparing for its first-ever crewed spaceflight as astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali joins the crew of the Shenzhou-24 mission, heading to China's Tiangong space station. The launch is scheduled for Wednesday at 8:18am Beijing time, which is 5:18am Pakistan time, departing from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre in north-western China as announced by the China Manned Space Agency. Ali will participate as a payload specialist alongside Chinese commander Tang Hongbo and flight engineer Wu Yi, making him the first Pakistani national in space and the first foreign visitor to the Tiangong laboratory.

During his approximately one-week stay in orbit, Ali will perform routine crew duties and conduct scientific experiments under a bilateral space research framework between Pakistan and China. His work will involve installing research hardware and executing biotechnology experiments selected by the Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission from over 300 university proposals. These scientific activities focus on addressing food security and climate change challenges.

Ahead of the flight, Ali underwent rigorous preparation, including specialized spacecraft operations training, emergency simulations, and joint coordination drills with his Chinese crewmates. To accommodate his needs, the Astronaut Centre of China provided customized English-Chinese manuals and halal space food, alongside language instruction for technical communication. The final full-system rehearsal was successfully completed at Jiuquan on November 21.
